what: A four-voice synthesizer: two oscillators per voice, each STD (8 waves), SUPER (7 saws), WT (wavetables) or GRAIN (granular); a 12/24 dB multimode filter, two ADSRs, two LFOs, unison, delay, reverb and stereo chorus. 14 factory presets, 16 of yours. Play it in the browser first.
author: Orian Beltrame
